datasets.name: d81999c2
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT_IF(detected_at >= current_date())            AS alerts_today,
  COUNT_IF(date >= date_sub(current_date(), 7))      AS alerts_7d
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_alerts

datasets.name: ef232e03
queryLines:
SELECT date, ticker, alert_type,
       ROUND(value_pct, 1) AS value_pct, ROUND(threshold_pct, 1) AS threshold_pct,
       message, detected_at
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_alerts

datasets.name: 765ec642
queryLines:
SELECT run_at, check_name, severity, status, failed_count, sample
FROM workspace.market_watch.dq_results
WHERE run_at = (SELECT MAX(run_at) FROM workspace.market_watch.dq_results)

datasets.name: c11367ad
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(run_at)                                           AS last_run,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL' AND severity = 'ERROR')      AS errors,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL' AND severity = 'WARN')       AS warnings
FROM workspace.market_watch.dq_results
WHERE run_at = (SELECT MAX(run_at) FROM workspace.market_watch.dq_results)

datasets.name: 686a5fdf
queryLines:
SELECT date, concat(ticker_a, ' × ', ticker_b) AS pair, ROUND(corr_90d, 2) AS corr_90d
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_correlations
WHERE corr_90d IS NOT NULL
  AND date >= add_months(current_date(), -24)

datasets.name: a5e97ea9
queryLines:
WITH last AS (
  SELECT ticker, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_metrics
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT
  g.ticker, w.note AS name, g.asset_type, g.date,
  ROUND(g.adj_close, 2)          AS price,
  g.currency,
  ROUND(g.ret_1d_pct, 2)         AS ret_1d_pct,
  ROUND(g.ret_1w_pct, 2)         AS ret_1w_pct,
  ROUND(g.ret_1m_pct, 2)         AS ret_1m_pct,
  ROUND(g.drawdown_52w_pct, 2)   AS drawdown_52w_pct,
  ROUND(g.pct_vs_ma200, 2)       AS pct_vs_ma200,
  ROUND(g.rel_3m_vs_spy_pct, 2)  AS rel_3m_vs_spy_pct,
  ROUND(g.volume_ratio, 2)       AS volume_ratio,
  g.above_ma200, g.is_volatile
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_metrics g
JOIN last l ON g.ticker = l.ticker AND g.date = l.max_date
JOIN workspace.market_watch.silver_watchlist w ON g.ticker = w.ticker
WHERE w.is_active

datasets.name: 7f56607b
queryLines:
WITH last AS (
  SELECT ticker, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_metrics
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                     AS tickers,
  COUNT_IF(NOT g.above_ma200)                  AS below_ma200,
  COUNT_IF(g.is_volatile)                      AS volatile_now,
  datediff(current_date(), MIN(g.date))        AS data_age_days
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_metrics g
JOIN last l ON g.ticker = l.ticker AND g.date = l.max_date

datasets.name: 281d9035
queryLines:
SELECT
  ticker, date,
  ROUND(adj_close, 2)          AS price,
  ROUND(ma50, 2)               AS ma50,
  ROUND(ma200, 2)              AS ma200,
  ROUND(drawdown_52w_pct, 2)   AS drawdown_52w_pct,
  ROUND(rel_3m_vs_spy_pct, 2)  AS rel_3m_vs_spy_pct,
  ROUND(vol_20d_pct, 1)        AS vol_20d_pct,
  ROUND(vol_baseline_pct, 1)   AS vol_baseline_pct
FROM workspace.market_watch.gold_metrics
WHERE date >= add_months(current_date(), -36)
